subject: PARADOx Study - Avicenna Study Participants as "Test" instead of "Main"
body:
Hi Amin,

Our large data collection PARADOx is starting this next Monday. I just noticed in two of our studies (4050 – Tienertips (Jongeren) and 4051 – Tienertips (Ouders)) a very significant portion of our participants are labeled as “test” participant types instead of “main” participants. These are however all our main study participants. I believe this is because our enrollment started before the full license for these studies was applied.

Would it be possible for you to change all participants’ type to “main”? I don’t believe there is any way for us to change this from our end? I hope these participants will still receive all surveys as intended, as our study is starting after the weekend.

Best regards, on behalf of the PARADOx team,

Rick van Logchem
Promovendus | PARADOx-Project | Youth & Family

Department of Psychology, Education & Child Studies
Erasmus School of Social and Behavioural Sciences

subject: PARADOx Study - Avicenna Study Participants as "Test" instead of "Main"
body:
Hi Rick,

I just came across this question. You are right. We released this feature last month (https://forum.avicennaresearch.com/t/weekly-release-notes-2024-09-10/863) and since then, all participants in a "Trial Study" are marked as "Test" by default. I will ask my backend team to make this change by this weekend, but don't worry about it. There is no difference between Test and Main participant and there will be no interruption to your study flow.

Bests,
Mohammad
